tabs.tab_title: How much does property management cost in [City]?
tabs.tab_content: Full management is 8% of the monthly rent collected, and leasing only is 75% of the first month’s rent. There is a one-time $250 setup fee, with no hidden fees and no markup on maintenance.

tabs.tab_title: Can you manage my home if I live out of state or overseas?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Many owners live outside the Bay Area. You get online statements, photo inspection reports and one point of contact in English or Mandarin.
